text:
Raj Patel: Hey @people-ops — urgent approval needed for an offer going out tonight. Sr SWE candidate, UK-based but offer denominated in USD. Hiring manager requesting a comp-band uplift + early start. Quick details: base 140k USD -> requested 155k USD (band exception), 10k sign-on, PTO from day 1. Risk of losing to competing offer.
Priya Kumar: Thanks Raj. Can you paste the manager justification and the comparator market data? We need docs for comp-committee.
Raj Patel: Manager note: "Strong IC, 3 other companies active, immediate impact on infra team. Willing to add 6-month retention clause if needed." Market comps attached in the shared drive link: <https://redwood.internal/salary-comps/sr-swe-2026>.
Elena Gomez: If uplift moves candidate across band boundary we need formal exception routed to comp-committee + finance. For UK hires we also need the FX/top-up plan. Two paths: (A) approve uplift now and escalate to CFO if net uplift > $15k annual, or (B) offer sign-on frontload + prorated PTO to secure candidate while committee reviews.
Tom Li: Hiring manager here — prefer path A if possible. Candidate needs a written number tonight. If committee can't meet, we accept B with the sign-on staged (5k now, 5k after 6mo).
Priya Kumar: OK routing I propose: 1) Finance quick review (Raj@finance) — confirm budget/forecast impact, 2) Comp-committee (Elena, Priya, Marla) — approve exception, 3) Exec (CFO) only if uplift > 15k. I've created the exception form below.
Priya Kumar: ```EXCEPTION FORM
Candidate: Sr SWE (UK)
Current band offer: S3 140k USD
Requested: S4 155k USD (+11%)
Sign-on: 10k USD (staged)
Start window: flexible, earliest 2026-05-04
Manager justification: retention risk, immediate project need
Docs: salary comps + manager note linked
```
Marla Ortiz: Reviewing comps now — I can jump on a 10-min sync if helpful. From glance comps justify moving to S4 for this role.
comp-committee-bot: Exception PO-7421 created and routed: finance -> comp-committee. Status: pending finance review.
Raj Patel: Noted. If finance gives green light, can we fast-track committee sign-off today? Candidate deadline is EOD.
Elena Gomez: I'll chair an emergency sign-off. If finance approves within 3 hours, committee will rubber-stamp with manager retention clause. If finance needs more time, proceed with staged sign-on (Tom to confirm).
Tom Li: Confirmed — proceed with staged sign-on fallback if committee not done by EOD. Please keep me posted here. :thumbsup:
Priya Kumar: Thanks team — I've CC'd Raj@finance. Will update thread when PO-7421 moves.
comp-committee-bot: Finance approved (budget ok). PO-7421 -> comp-committee for final approval.
Elena Gomez: Comp-committee approved exception (S4 155k + staged 10k sign-on, PTO pro-rated starting day 1). Will log in Workday and issue offer. Action items: Priya to record exception, Tom to confirm draft offer text, Raj to confirm payment staging.
Raj Patel: Payment staging confirmed.
Tom Li: Offer draft approved by manager. Send pls.
Elena Gomez: Offer dispatched and candidate accepted verbally. Closing thread — exception reference PO-7421 recorded in case system. :tada:
